snippet.title: Synth Riders x Crypt of the NecroDancer Music Pack | Nintendo Switch
snippet.description:
Wishlist or Buy Synth Riders:
- https://www.nintendo.com/us/store/products/synth-riders-switch/

Dive into the rhythm of the dungeon with the Crypt of the NecroDancer Music Pack in Synth Riders on Nintendo Switch. Featuring the original, high-energy soundtrack from Crypt of the NecroDancer, this pack brings fast-paced beats and iconic tracks into a precision-driven rhythm experience.

Stay on beat and test your timing with a tracklist built for speed, flow, and challenge:

Crypt of the NecroDancer Set List:
1️⃣ Rhythmortis
2️⃣ Konga Conga Kappa
3️⃣ Disco Descent
4️⃣ Fungal Funk
5️⃣ Styx and Stones

Each song is carefully mapped to match the intensity and tempo of the music, creating a satisfying gameplay experience that rewards accuracy and rhythm. Whether you're a fan of NecroDancer or discovering these tracks for the first time, this pack delivers a unique crossover of two rhythm worlds.

Available now in Synth Riders on Nintendo Switch.

Follow Synth Riders on socials:
- @synthridersgg 

Join the Community and chat with the devs:
- discord.gg/synthriders

#partygames #switch #rhythmgame
